name: protection-rule
description: Custom deployment protection rule per environment: approves only a verified plan plus CEO GO (migration apply) or a CEO GO for the exact head SHA (production), rejects everything else.

scripts.test: node --test test/decide.test.mjs test/verify.test.mjs test/app.test.mjs test/evidence.test.mjs test/board.test.mjs test/environments.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs test/title-fallback.test.mjs
scripts.check: for file in src/*.js test/*.mjs test/*.cjs; do node --check "$file" || exit; done
